First-party verify-domain guide checked 2026-10-28. The apex TXT example uses the mistral-domain-verification= prefix and is a precondition for email-domain authentication, SAML SSO, and other enterprise access features. It does not prove those features are enabled. A separate SSO quickstart documents a different TXT name and value; that shape is not added here.
